component.name: OpenWitty
component.summary: Experimental Linux control application for the LEWITT CONNECT 2

description.p: OpenWitty is an independent, open-source Linux control application for LEWITT CONNECT audio interfaces (initially the CONNECT 2). It is not affiliated with, endorsed by or supported by LEWITT.

Status: first release, tested with one CONNECT 2 on one Linux system (KDE Plasma 6, PipeWire). It controls every setting that was verified on the real device (inputs, processing, monitoring, outputs, LEDs, custom button, 48 V, routing, Autosetup, presets), keeps the desktop volume in step with the volume knob, also through an optional background service and tray icon, and gives the inputs readable desktop names. Firmware update and factory reset are not part of OpenWitty and the CONNECT 6 is not supported.
Access to the real device needs a USB permission rule installed by an administrator (included in distribution packages).
First public release: full control of the CONNECT 2, desktop volume integration, background service, tray icon, presets and desktop names for inputs and output.
First alpha (prepared, not yet published): live read-only view of one CONNECT 2, desktop volume integration with an optional background service and system tray icon, simulated device.
